previous_release: R005 treasures/daily mischief/chirps; R004 C.Link terminal; R001 pet save unchanged
author: Lenore Studio
canonical_state: single design and identity, not a globally running pet

visuals.appearance: 8-bit black cat, yellow eyes, plum ears, magenta nose, cyan whiskers
visuals.source: the existing approved Studio header SVG is cloned into the playable room
visuals.design_lock: Human explicitly requested a C.Link appliance-style Personal Planner on 2026-10-28; ODD FM pixel cat and palette retained
visuals.interface: Fixed viewport and seven switchable Studio stations; upper-right cat opens quick care instead of scrolling; flyout utility menus
visuals.interaction: Six draggable care icons surround the room cat; drop on the sprite or click/tap a tool; pointer, keyboard and touch input supported
visuals.reactions: Brief original floating icons after care, occasional eye blink, optional quiet synthesized chirps gated by a user-controlled SOUND toggle (off by default and stored locally)

care.minigame: catch five pixel mice within eighteen seconds
care.mementos: Eight low-pressure tiny treasures derived from existing R001 stats/achievements (no extra save fields or penalty)
care.postcard: One original quirky cat line per local calendar day, deterministic and repeatable; no streaks or network calls
care.box_game: Optional cardboard-box hide-and-seek: find Gremelkin behind one of three boxes across three rounds, with comic decoys, replay, Escape and keyboard buttons. Uses existing TALK action as completion reward, no new save schema.

storage.restore: manual JSON import with identity/schema validation
storage.privacy: never publish player local save or identifiers
storage.optional_preference: ODDFM.GREMELKIN.R005.SOUND (off by default; local only; portable pet save format unaffected)
storage.r006: R006 box game uses only transient in-memory round state; no added localStorage keys or new export fields

presence.current: Studio page only; localStorage tab lease best effort
presence.future_invariant: only one ACTIVE guest visit worldwide, enforced by a real atomic server lease with fencing epochs

director_note: R006 adds an optional single-screen game while keeping R001 core, save format, and R005 behavior unchanged. 9/9 rule tests + 360/390/1280 synthetic fixture tests PASS; production Pages deployment and Human Firefox approval remain unverified.
